summary: UHF RFID paper labels combine a printable thermal-transfer or direct-thermal paper face with an embedded UHF RFID inlay — enabling simultaneous barcode printing and RFID encoding in a single pass on standard RFID label printers. The most widely deployed RFID form factor in retail and logistics.
